run_merge_traj: run the merge_traj script to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into a single full trajectory file
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a ZIP archive to a given directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP checkpoint files into a single ASE trajectory using the main function
create_full_trajectory: create a full trajectory file from sorted checkpoint ZIP files and a final relaxation output
refactor_merge_traj_efficiency: refactor the merge_traj main function to improve efficiency for larger systems
